idea-plugin.name: Atlassian Teamwork Graph CLI
idea-plugin.description:
Teamwork Graph CLI is Atlassian's agent-first interface to your entire work context: Jira issues, Confluence pages, Bitbucket pull requests, and connected third-party data.

Use it from your terminal or coding agent to:

  • Search connected work and find the most relevant context.
  • Map ownership, experts, dependencies, and related work.
  • Summarize status, triage reviews, prepare handoffs, and update work.

Try: "What PRs are waiting on me, and which reviews are stale?"

Run TWG: Set Up from Find Action or the Tools menu. The plugin opens a visible, interactive terminal and starts the official installer after you confirm. Teamwork Graph CLI owns installation, browser sign-in, credential storage, skills, and health checks.

Teamwork Graph CLI documentation
idea-plugin.change-notes: • Added fresh-install onboarding with a direct Teamwork Graph CLI setup action.
